decisions.decision: Task 1 checkpoint (09-01): option-a -- deploy-nonprod VM identity confined by Unix permissions only, one Docker Hub token duplicated into both GitHub Environments
decisions.rationale: Matches every proportionality call already locked in CONTEXT.md (D-02, D-04); residual risks written into docs/INFRA_RUNBOOK.md as explicitly accepted

decisions.decision: NETCUP_HOST_FINGERPRINT must be the VM's ECDSA host key fingerprint (SHA256:gwhi3vhsQHP5yKmROGHMDPoWP1fENBUbo2e4s3WHVQc), NOT its ED25519 fingerprint, despite ED25519 being independently correct and verified three ways
decisions.rationale: appleboy/ssh-action's underlying easyssh-proxy -> golang.org/x/crypto/ssh client ranks ECDSA above ED25519 in its default HostKeyAlgorithms preference (golang/go#51168), unlike a normal OpenSSH client

decisions.decision: docker-compose.nonprod.yml's image: line now points at rudenkovladimir/kanban-board-backend-nonprod, not the production repository name it inherited from Phase 8
decisions.rationale: Task 3 of 09-01 built and pushed a second image tag to the new nonprod repository, but nothing had updated the Compose file that pulls it -- it silently deployed production's repository content instead (byte-identical, but not real separation and not what CI-03 requires)

next_action: Dispatch plan 09-02 (Wave 2). It is autonomous (no checkpoint), depends only on 09-01 (now complete), so it can run as a background worktree-isolated gsd-executor without needing the operator present -- unlike 09-01. Standard execute-phase wave dispatch applies.
context_notes: Phase 9 Wave 1 (09-01 + 09-04) is genuinely done -- not just committed, but live-verified: a real production deploy ran green, and docker inspect on the VM confirmed nonprod pulls from its own Docker Hub repository (rudenkovladimir/kanban-board-backend-nonprod), not production's. Getting there required going past 'the executor returned success' twice: once to catch a wrong-repository-name bug in an unrelated Phase 8 file the plan never scoped to touch, and once to root-cause an SSH fingerprint mismatch that turned out to be a Go standard-library default-ordering quirk, not a wrong value. Two new supply-chain hardening todos were also captured this session (Gradle dependency verification metadata; Gradle wrapper integrity validation in CI) as candidates for Phase 10's own planning -- see .planning/todos/pending/2026-08-18-add-gradle-*.md. Note: 09-03 (Wave 3) has its own blocking checkpoint like 09-01 did, so when that wave comes up, expect another pause for human decision + possible VM/secret involvement, same pattern as this session.
